details:
Q1. Which part of this repository should be improved?
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan phase workflows or prompts
B. Implement / review-autofix / conflict-resolution workflows or scripts
C. Orchestrator / judge / validate / stall-recovery workflows or scripts
D. Documentation / README / operator guidance only
E. Other — specify the exact workflow, script, prompt, or file path in `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want in that area?
Choices:
A. Fix a bug or regression
B. Reduce flaky failures / improve reliability
C. Improve performance / API usage / cost
D. Improve documentation / readability / operator UX
E. Other — describe the exact problem and desired outcome in `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
Q3. What concrete reference should implementation follow?
Choices:
A. I will name a specific workflow run, issue, PR, log snippet, or file in `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
B. I will describe the exact user-visible behavior that should change in `/answer`
C. There is no existing reference; use only the area from Q1 and objective from Q2
